# Vanessa Flow Yoga

> A warm, welcoming yoga studio in Clitheroe, Ribble Valley (UK). Hot yoga, Pilates, Barre, gentle, restorative and more. Over 30 classes a week, all levels, no experience needed.

New visitors usually start with the 21-day intro pass (£35). Booking is handled through Momence. Ages 18+ on their own, 14 to 17 welcome with an accompanying adult.

## Key pages

- [Intro pass](https://vanessaflowyoga.co.uk/intro-pass): 21 days of unlimited classes for £35, the best entry point for new students.
- [Class timetable](https://vanessaflowyoga.co.uk/classes): the full weekly schedule of classes.
- [Membership and pricing](https://vanessaflowyoga.co.uk/membership): subscription tiers, class packs and drop-in prices.
- [Events and workshops](https://vanessaflowyoga.co.uk/events): one-off events, workshops and retreats.
- [About and team](https://vanessaflowyoga.co.uk/about): the studio story and the teachers.
- [Blog](https://vanessaflowyoga.co.uk/blog): articles on yoga, wellbeing and getting started.
- [Contact](https://vanessaflowyoga.co.uk/contact): how to reach the studio and where to find us.

## Optional

- [FAQ](https://vanessaflowyoga.co.uk/faq): common questions on classes, what to bring and first visits.
- [Private and corporate](https://vanessaflowyoga.co.uk/private-corporate): private group and workplace class options.
- [Terms](https://vanessaflowyoga.co.uk/terms): booking, membership and studio terms.

## Location

The Beauty Boutique, Link 59 Business Park, Unit 5, Clitheroe, BB7 1QJ, United Kingdom.
